title: Spreadsheets for farm records and profit
why: Knowing your real costs, yields and profit per crop, pond or pen is the difference between guessing and growing.
what_is_different: Farm records follow the season and the field or flock, not the calendar month. They mix money, inputs, labour and yields, and must be quick to fill in on a phone in the field.

extra_modules.title: Phone-friendly record sheets
extra_modules.outcome: You can: record in the field with Google Sheets on your phone
extra_modules.practice: Set up an inputs and sales log on your phone

extra_modules.title: Cost and profit per enterprise
extra_modules.outcome: You can: see which crop or batch actually makes money
extra_modules.practice: Compare gross margin for two crops or two batches

starter_project: Track one full season (or one poultry or fish batch): inputs, labour, sales and mortality/yield, ending with gross margin and break-even price.
pitfalls: Forgetting family labour and transport costs
Recording at the end of the season from memory

expert_validation.note: AI-drafted outline; to be validated by a practitioner and an educator in this field.
